facts:
## CELL FACTS

Cell 土_正财 (Earth carrying The Steward). Persona The Steward (正财). Definition line: "Methodical, directed acquisition, the value built and kept". Keyword Caution, charge gentle, poles catalyst Security / friction Hoarding. Family function: Action. Cost dimension: value built and kept; counting what others spend freely. Arena: granary, kept things, stone by stone, seasons of saving. Classical portrait: methodical, directed acquisition; value built and kept; caution, thrift, the slow ledger. Ruled domains: Wealth, Savings, Steady love. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 偏财.
Element arena: Earth (ground, soil, load, field, bedrock, harvest). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Wood. structural_interaction seed: "Wood directing Earth cross-polarity — reach shaping stability into structured cultivation".
- k2_overview: "Your Earth moves as the Steward: ground that keeps. This is stewardship in its home element, doubled: holdings maintained, households provisioned, value settled into soil. What enters your care appreciates. The risk is weight for its own sake. Keep the estate serving the family, not the family serving the estate."
- k2_functional: "You maintain relentlessly: the fixed fence, the paid tax, the kept schedule."
- adj_chips: {"friction":["Hoarding","Immobile","Cheap"],"catalyst":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Wealth":"Your wealth is literal ground: property, durables, enterprises with deeds. In your element, holdings hold. Diversify just enough that one bad season cannot take the whole farm.","Savings":"You save geologically: layers on layers, bedrock reserves. The craft is knowing enough. Set the number, then let the surplus fund life above ground.","Steady love":"You love in permanence: home built, name shared, decades assumed. It is the marrying ground itself. Bring the assumption out loud sometimes. Even bedrock likes being chosen again."}
- fn_reading.catalyst.ledger (three rows, index-aligned to adj_chips.catalyst; authored order is significance order):
  - row 0: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 1: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 2: [REDACTED: the target row]
- Sibling cell 土_偏财 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Shrewd","Well-traveled","Overflowing"],"friction":["Land-hungry","Never-settled","Spread-thin"]}
- Sibling cell 土_偏财 catalyst row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Reading the real value of things is your standing talent, and it works on houses, people, and offers alike. You see the water damage behind the fresh paint and the good bones behind the ugly listing. Bad deals rarely survive your first slow walk around them."

Core element Wood, energy element Earth. Law: Wood tames Earth (木克土: roots hold the hillside). Relative to the core the energy is the tamed, so Earth is this core's Action. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Wood core that shows Earth on the catalyst pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The catalyst pole of Earth as the Action is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels); tone by pole: compliment. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 木_土's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.

value.text: Making a thing last is a craft you practice without noticing. Waste feels to you like a small loss of control, so you repair what you own rather than replace it. Keep at it, and accept the older version a while longer than you need.

value_b.text: Whatever you own, you keep working for years. Buying new feels like giving up on something, and that puts fixing ahead of replacing every time. Keep making things last, and let a few of them go while they still have worth to someone.

value.text: You keep old things going for everyone around you. Fixing beats choosing for you, and you have the people at home living with your kept things rather than their own. Let someone else pick one new thing a year, since you make the rest last.

value.text: Saving comes first for you, ahead of the treat and the trip. A cushion is what lets you relax, so you put money away rather than enjoy it. Keep saving first, and let the price be a few good things you were slow to buy.

value_b.text: Money feels like yours only after part of it is put away. Being covered matters more to you than being treated, and the saving comes before the spending. Keep that order, and spend one saved thing on yourself from time to time.

value.text: Saving first is the quiet skill under everything you own. You would rather be covered than pleased, and the good thing you can afford keeps waiting. Spend one saved sum on something you want, since the pleasure you put off is the real price.

value.text: Being loyal costs you less than leaving ever would. The known thing keeps you safe, and you stay with what you have rather than look at what else there is. Stay loyal, and know the price is staying a while past where it serves you.

value_b.text: Loyalty is your default, given before it is asked for. Choosing again asks less of you than starting fresh, and that puts the person you have ahead of anyone new. Keep giving it, and let the few people you never met be the price.

value.text: Your loyalty stays put, and it pays in people who stay. You keep choosing what is yours rather than ask if it chooses you too. Ask every so often, since loyalty to what does not love you back is closeness you go without.

value.text: Loyalty is how you love, lived rather than said. Choosing someone again matters to you more than saying so, and you let the staying stand in for the words. Say it out loud sometimes, since being chosen again only counts when it is said.
